rule.title: Button Loading State and Disabled Accessibility

component_rules.rule: While an asynchronous action is executing, buttons must display an inline spinner, maintain their exact layout width to prevent content reflow, and have aria-busy='true' and disabled attributes set.
All interactive buttons on mobile and desktop viewports must maintain a touch/click target of at least 48x48px per Fitts's Law (UI-LAW-002).

rule.title: Single Primary Button Per Visual Area

component_rules.rule: Each view or modal card must present at most one primary solid-color call-to-action button to eliminate visual competition and cognitive friction.
